- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Grace is a pretty tomboy with golden-brown hair, dark-brown or golden-brown eyes, dimples, and a lively, flush-cheeked face. She is noted for her bold expressions and wild, golden-brown ringlets.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c3 P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015), [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)_

## Personality

Grace is high-spirited, cheerful, and impulsive, often acting on instinct before thinking things through. She possesses immense courage, a quick temper, and a fiercely loyal devotion to her family and friends. Unafraid to confront others or speak her mind, she harbors a strong sense of justice and deeply despises cruelty.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P31](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0031), [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c5 P21](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0021), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P27](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0027), [v5 c7 P31](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0031)_

## Goals

- Protect her siblings and defend her father's reputation  <sub>[v5 c5 P20](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0020), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P27](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0027)</sub>
- Ensure her family stays together at the Glen St. Agnes manse  <sub>[v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)</sub>

## History

Grace grew up in Juneford before moving to Glen St. Agnes with her father, brothers Tobias and Rupert, sister Ida, and Aunt Martha. She quickly became close friends with the Carrow children, spending leisure hours in Fern Hollow. After mistaken days led Grace and Ida to clean house on Sunday, Grace wrote a public letter to the Journal to clear her father of any fault. Later, when she heard rumours that the parish might lose its funding, Grace bravely confronted Lionel Fairlie; her spirited outburst won him over, prompting him to resume attending church and financial support. Grace also took in the runaway orphan Mary Stubbs and defended her younger brother Edmund after he fought Dan Coyle for insulting her. In time, she welcomed Clementine Ainslie as a maternal friend and future stepmother.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P4](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0004), [v5 c4 P42](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0042), [v5 c5 P45](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0045), [v5 c7 P27](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0027), [v5 c10 P18](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0018), [v5 c10 P27](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0027), [v5 c12 P25](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0025), [v5 c16 P49](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0049), [v5 c16 P59](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0059), [v5 c17 P14](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0014), [v5 c17 P27](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0027), [v5 c20 P20](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0020), [v5 c20 P31](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0031)_
